method: Direct visual inspection of every Poppler PNG page at 1500 pixels; no contact sheets or inferred page checks.

nonblocking_defects.description: The single-line lead-in beginning 'Con xi = 2 meV y Delta = 1 meV, los valores propios se obtienen de' remains at the bottom of page 15, while its equation E.7 starts page 16. Both are fully readable, but keeping this line with the equation would improve continuity.

These are terminal class pages occupying approximately the top quarter of the text area: remaining E06 activities and sources on page 14, all E03 activities and source on page 19. Roughly 70-75 percent of the usable page is blank. This follows the separate-page start for each class; it does not truncate content.
